quality.review_scope: Independent scientific audit of both complete supplied main pages, both source figures and the bounded R2 caption correction passed. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Both supplied main pages (875–876), both figures, full preparation/continuation, solvent controls, proposed interpretation and twelve references visually read. SI and cited full papers unreviewed. The scanned source has no verified text cache.

Lead acetate hydration, absolute precursor masses, solvent volume, numerical selenium saturation concentration, mixing/dissolution duration and addition order are unreported. The typical XRD/TEM sample is specifically tied to 0.05 kmol/m³ lead acetate in selenium-saturated ethylenediamine.

The 60Co source activity is 2.59×10^15 Bq and irradiation dose is 3.0×10^4 Gy. Irradiation duration, dose rate, source distance, energy spectrum, vessel and oxygen/purge conditions are unreported; no exposure time is derived.

Room temperature and ambient pressure are qualitative. The general ambient-pressure wording does not override the explicitly reported vacuum drying step. Several hours of post-irradiation standing is qualitative; only the vacuum drying time is numerically 4 h.

Collection technique, wash amounts/repetitions, dilute-acetic-acid concentration, vacuum level, drying apparatus, yield and storage are unreported. Wash order is absolute ethanol, distilled water, dilute acetic acid, then acetone.

Figure 2 explicitly depicts the same sample as Figure 1. No physical batch identifier, TEM specimen preparation/grid, XRD holder, particle-count statistic, size uncertainty or distribution width is given. Average TEM particle size is 30 nm; no XRD crystallite size is reported.

Benzene and tetrahydrofuran controls give neither a homogeneous selenium-containing solution nor PbSe under irradiation. Their charges, irradiation dose/time and subsequent processing are not individually stated and are not copied from the successful ethylenediamine route.

Formation chemistry is explicitly unknown and the solvent/solvated-electron explanation is proposed. No intermediate, kinetic rate, product atomic coordinates or current optical/electronic property measurement is supplied.
Generic molecular references and source-bound apparatus concepts are not measured solution, particle or apparatus geometry. Full molecular/crystal/presentation refinements remain pending.
